examples.description: Signed evidence pack for a Norwegian company over the default window

description: One signed JSON record of what Apier observed about a Norwegian company today: the check bundle, archived changes in the window (`changes_from`, at most 366 days back), your receipts, each archived record's daily anchor proof when available (else pending or proof_unavailable), coverage window and source licences. A record of observation, not a verdict, no admissibility claim. The user can save the `result` object as a .json file and open it at https://www.apier.no/evidence-pack/viewer to verify it. Errors: VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND, ENTITY_REMOVED; a credential without `read:brreg` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). No API key? Use Bearer apier_sandbox_test_<suffix> (a fresh suffix) to get fixtures; valid orgs are the 818, 99966 and 99977 series and 999000002 (see GET /api/v1/sandbox/fixtures). Cost: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per call, prepaid (prices: the get_pricing tool or GET /api/v1/pricing). Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/evidence-pack
description_nb: Én signert JSON-oversikt over hva Apier har observert om et norsk selskap i dag: sjekkpakken, alle arkiverte endringer i perioden (`changes_from`, høyst 366 dager tilbake), dine egne kvitteringer for selskapet, hver arkiverte oppføring med ankerbeviset for dagen, dekningsperioden og lisensen for hver kilde. Den er en oversikt over observasjoner, aldri en konklusjon, og hevder ikke at den kan brukes som bevis i retten. Signaturen kan kontrolleres uten nett mot /.well-known/jwks.json for produksjonspakker eller /.well-known/sandbox-jwks.json for sandkassepakker; brukeren kan lagre objektet `result` som en .json-fil og åpne den på https://www.apier.no/evidence-pack/viewer uten nøkkel. Bruk get_company_verification for en status og get_company_context for identitet. Krever read:brreg. Kostnad: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per kall, forhåndsbetalt (priser: verktøyet get_pricing eller GET /api/v1/pricing).

changes_from.description: Start of the change window as a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today minus 366 days. Never after today and at most 366 days before it; a date before the archive start is answered as asked, with the coverage window saying what is covered.

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (Brønnøysund ID); MOD-11-checked up-front — a failing value is rejected as VALIDATION_FAILED, so correct the number rather than retrying it.

name: get_company_evidence_pack

outputSchema.description: Apier envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The /evidence-pack response: the signed `pack` and its `public_log` entry. Save this `result` object (not the whole MCP envelope) as a .json file to keep or hand on; it verifies offline and in the keyless viewer.

title: Signed evidence pack of what Apier observed about a company
